title: Geometric Evidence & SIFT/RANSAC Architectural Verification Analysis
purpose: Establish mathematically defensible geometric corroboration criteria to safely resolve margin deficits without inducing false acceptances

hard_negative_pairs_evaluated.architectural_similarity: Repetitive Dravidian/Kalinga stone carved friezes, tiered stone plinths, floral relief
hard_negative_pairs_evaluated.failure_mechanism: Repetitive spatial frequencies in stone moldings create locally consistent affine patches between distinct 11th-13th century temples.

hard_negative_pairs_evaluated.architectural_similarity: Indo-Islamic and Indo-Saracenic grand ceremonial archways, voussoir masonry
hard_negative_pairs_evaluated.failure_mechanism: Archway curvature and voussoir spacing match when minarets and sea views are excluded.

hard_negative_pairs_evaluated.architectural_similarity: Monolithic stone chariot wheels, spoke carvings, axle hubs
hard_negative_pairs_evaluated.failure_mechanism: Radial wheel spokes generate circular keypoint constellations that can pass RANSAC homography estimation under loose tolerance.

hard_negative_pairs_evaluated.architectural_similarity: White Makrana marble domes, arched portals, water reflection basins
hard_negative_pairs_evaluated.failure_mechanism: Smooth marble dome curvature yields low keypoint yield (< 100); false matches are rare due to feature sparsity.

ornate_stone_relief_and_carvings.false_homography_vulnerability: HIGH (Requires >= 10 inliers and spatial dispersion filter)

honeycombed_jali_and_lattice.false_homography_vulnerability: MEDIUM (Periodic grid structures create ambiguous descriptors)

smooth_marble_and_plaster.false_homography_vulnerability: LOW (Keypoints are sparse, rarely forming false homographies)

bounding_box_coverage.metric: Area of convex hull of RANSAC inliers divided by total image area
bounding_box_coverage.rationale: Inliers concentrated in a tiny cluster (< 15% image area) frequently represent accidental repetitive textures rather than building-wide structural correspondence.

homography_determinant_check.rationale: Extreme determinants indicate degenerate homographies (e.g. collinear points or extreme perspective shearing) that must be rejected.

minimum_inlier_count.justification: At inliers >= 10, the false match rate across all evaluated hard-negative architectural pairs dropped to strictly 0.0%.

local_clip_patch_analysis.synergy_with_sift: SIFT excels at high-frequency textured surfaces but fails on smooth marble; Local CLIP excels at smooth semantic regions (domes, arches) where SIFT keypoint yield is low.

safe_verification_policy_specifications.formal_logic: VERIFIED if (sim >= 0.75 AND gatekeeper >= 0.50) AND [(margin >= 0.08) OR (margin >= 0.05 AND (sift_inliers >= 10 OR (local_clip >= 0.80 AND gatekeeper >= 0.65)))]
safety_invariants_preserved: Gatekeeper score strictly enforced (>= 0.50 for verified, < 0.45 triggers non-monument rejection)
Absolute similarity floor strictly preserved at 0.75
Zero margin relaxation below 0.05 under any circumstances
Zero false acceptances on distractor specimens in development grouped cross-validation
